title: Clarinet — 85–114 dB
description: Measured performance levels for clarinet run 85–114 dB, spanning from about 147 Hz into the altissimo register. High frequencies of 2,000–4,000 Hz are the most damaging, and aging steals the highs first. Used in rehearsal room design.

spec.frequency_range: from about 147 Hz into the altissimo register
